title: Multi-detent refractive bottom sheet
blurb: A three-detent bottom sheet drawn over a live street map inside one WebGL 2 canvas. It hands off continuous drags between an inner scrollable list and the sheet frame at scrollTop === 0, while scaling, dimming and edge-refracting the map under morphing rounded corners.
question: Can a single WebGL canvas coordinate a 3-detent spring-physics bottom sheet with single-gesture nested-scroll handoff (scrollTop === 0 transition into sheet drag) while progressively blurring, dimming and edge-refracting a live interactive backdrop beneath rounded corners?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL canvas uploads both the interactive map backdrop and the scrollable sheet via texElementSubImage2D(), hands off downward drags from #sheet-scroll at scrollTop === 0 in one pointer sequence, runs a velocity-aware spring across 18%, 52% and 90% detents (snapping straight to target under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), and keeps buttons on both layers clickable via updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit().
